name: Angela Yuson Lee
affiliation: Postdoctoral Research Fellow, Center for Digital Health & Tech, Impact, and Policy Center
Incoming Assistant Professor, School of Journalism & Mass Communication, UW–Madison (Fall 2026)
bio: I am a Postdoctoral Research Fellow in the Center for Digital Health and the Tech, Impact, and Policy Center at Stanford University. In fall of 2026, I will be joining the University of Wisconsin–Madison as an Assistant Professor in the School of Journalism and Mass Communication.

My research program takes a media psychological approach to examining the effects of news and mass communication on psychological well-being and belief in (mis)information. My work uses rigorous mixed-methods and community-engaged practices to investigate how diverse audiences perceive, use, and respond to technologies, such as social media, personalized algorithms, and artificial intelligence (AI). In particular, I develop interventions that support people in obtaining the benefits of new technologies while being aware and resilient to its potential harms.
I received my Ph.D. in Communication from Stanford University, where I worked in the Social Media Lab with Professor Jeff Hancock. I also received my B.A. in Psychology and Communication at Stanford.
